maintenance_items.label: Battery health & BMS
maintenance_items.description: Connect diagnosis tool to monitor cell degradation, capacity parameters, and balance individual cell voltages.

maintenance_items.label: High-voltage wiring
maintenance_items.description: Visually inspect insulation status of orange high-voltage cables, connectors, and ensure no moisture ingress.

maintenance_items.label: Inverter & motor cooling
maintenance_items.description: If liquid-cooled, check specific coolant level and top up. If air-cooled, clean cooling fins from mud and debris.

maintenance_items.label: Firmware / software updates
maintenance_items.description: Update the Vehicle Control Unit firmware for optimizations in power delivery, regen braking, and efficiency.

maintenance_items.label: Reduction gearbox lubricant
maintenance_items.description: Drain and replace the small amount of oil inside the central motor reduction gear mechanism.
